doc.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995

title: Thanks and goodbyes
summary: Rowe thanks Hampton on behalf of Hamilton College; Hampton jokes about renaming it and says he waited to be interviewed.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well that’s a very positive outlook. And on behalf of Hamilton College, I want to thank you for joining us today. This was just fascinating. And we really appreciate your time.
Well I’m glad to do it for the College. That’s Hamilton College.
It just might be we’ll have you up there and re-name the college. There’s a friend of yours over there. Thank you so much.
Thank you, too. And I want to say you know — this is more — I’ve been waiting to be interviewed by a gentleman of your caliber.
